contradict_spans: thyroid peroxidase antibodies <10 IU/mL
concepts.why: Autoimmune destruction of the thyroid gland could explain the abnormal thyroid function tests, but the absence of thyroid peroxidase antibodies makes this diagnosis less likely.

support_spans: pain starting 5–6 days after each shot

contradict_spans: no history of thyroid disease, head or neck radiation, or family history of head and neck cancer
concepts.why: The presence of a heterogeneous mass in the thyroid gland could suggest metastatic disease, but the absence of a known primary thyroid cancer and the patient's history of colon adenocarcinoma make this diagnosis less likely.
